prompt: A creature sprite for RimWorld: the Unfinished. A chimera budded by the Contagion's red goo, one part finished and the rest abandoned mid-thought. The creature stands on exactly three whole cloven-hooved legs; its fourth leg (the near hind leg in the east view) ends above the knee in a short raw red goo stump that hangs clear of the ground, shown the same on every facing. The body balances visibly on the three whole legs in a lopsided stance, weight shifted away from the dangling stump, so it reads as crippled and unfinished. A single useless half-formed wing rises from the creature's right shoulder (on the viewer's right in the rear view, seen from behind), with a hanging lump of goo-flesh on the same side. A jaw sits on a body that cannot eat, its parts mismatched. The hindquarters are a patchwork of unformed raw red goo-flesh and mismatched skin of different colours and textures, with no regular coat pattern; odd parts are spread from head to tail, so no part reads as a whole Earth animal. Raw red flesh from the Contagion's goo shows wherever the body is unfinished. Realistic painterly vanilla RimWorld sprite style, clean dark outline, soft painted edges in a deeper shade of the local colour. Exactly ONE creature, centred, the whole body visible with nothing cut off. Fully transparent background: no ground, no water, no shadow, no text, no border.
